meta.title: Workspace displays
meta.description: Adds a "Shown workspaces" section to the sidebar's view-options menu (the sliders button at the top-right of the Workspaces list). Each workspace has a row there; a trailing check means it is shown. Removing the check hides that workspace's group from the sidebar list, and checking it again — or "Show all workspaces" — brings it back. Hidden workspaces stay registered; their sessions, history and paths are untouched, and the choice is saved in this browser. Turning the plugin off restores every workspace. In Workspace Tree grouping a hidden parent also hides its children; the flat session list, search results and the workspace picker are not filtered.
